title: Ordinary SMP
description:
Vanilla | Java 26.2 | Whitelisted
Ordinary SMP is a tight-knit, active community where players from around the world come together to build, explore & have fun. Whether you are starting fresh or looking for your next Minecraft home, you're welcome here!
body:
**Ordinary SMP [Vanilla] {Fabric 26.2} {Whitelisted} {16+}**

Hey Crafters!

If you're looking for a long term survival server with a fresh world, active community and plenty of room to build, now is a great time to jump in.

Ordinary SMP is a community focused server inspired by the HermitCraft gameplay. Whether you enjoy building, redstone, exploring or simply hanging out with other players, there's a place for you here.

**What Makes Us Special?**
- Version: Always up to date. Season 4 is on **26.2** with all the latest features.
- Tight-Knit & Friendly Community: Join a diverse group of players who love to build & collaborate on exciting community projects.
- Grief Protection: We use Ledger to monitor player activity and can investigate griefing or theft to ensure your builds remain protected.

**Exciting Features!**
- AudioPlayer: Custom audio 
- Simple VoiceChat: Enhance your immersion and chat with fellow players in game.
- Dragon Elytra Drops
- Custom Resource Pack: Our server features a unique custom resource pack with exclusive cosmetics, trophies & event rewards that match our HermitCraft-inspired theme. Have an idea for custom items? We’d love to hear it!

**Who are we looking for?**
Builders, redstoners, explorers, shop owners, technical players, casual players. Anyone who enjoys being part of a long term community and wants a fresh start for the new season.

The world is still young, which means there are plenty of opportunities to establish your base, start shops, take part in community projects and help shape the future of the server.

Please note that Ordinary SMP is a **16+** community.

Want to see what our community has been up to? Check out our Season 3 Showcase: https://youtu.be/toEtDWm9hiY

If you're interested in joining, come say hello and submit an application through our Discord.
Discord: https://discord.gg/GjmY3mECSX

We'd love to see what you'll create in Season 4. See you in Ordinary SMP!
